name: [DUSTED CHAOS] Dusttale Soul Ops: Broken Route
desc:
2x EXP Event in new servers!

Trapped in a ghost town with nowhere to go, with enemies trying to take what's yours. Defend it, Defend the SOUL.

Fight against difficult bosses and get new characters. With a boss rush pattern where you will have to constantly get better and stronger. Of course, you have multiple ways to do so.

This game can be decently difficult at times, just because your unable to beat something doesn't mean the game is 
"unbalanced"

Styled Around Undertale And Dusttale
LEAVEING AND REJOINING SERVERS TO QUICKLY CAN CAUSE YOU TO LOSE DATA. It is rare though but still be careful when leaving and rejoining super quickly.
